item.title: Learning Without Bleeding: China’s Lessons from the Russia-Ukraine Drone War
item.description: China is using the Russia-Ukraine drone war as a military laboratory. Lilly Min-Chen Lee and Kateryna Bondar trace how quickly Chinese analysts identify battlefield innovations and how the PLA translates the lessons into training, procurement, hardware, and force structure.

item.title: 25 Years Since the Anthrax Attacks: Where Are We Now?
item.description: CSIS Global Health Policy Center moderated a discussion on how lessons learned from the 2001 anthrax attacks have been applied to the U.S. biodefense enterprise.

item.title: The AI Export Dilemma
item.description: In this week’s column, Bill Reinsch discusses whether the United States should allow exports of AI technologies and strategies the United States could employ to stay ahead in the global technology race.
